Score of 4 stands; note the newly launched Dzair Services platform (May 2026) is still actively building fresh civil-registry interoperability via the IRIES exchange network, indicating integration is real but not yet complete/universal.

revision_notes: Algeria's own 50-in-5 DPI pledge (April 2026) states its payments layer is "already mature and operating at scale" through Algeria Post (tens of millions of CCP accounts/Edahabia cards). This is well beyond "planned," so raised from 2 to 4 (Partially integrated); a standardised, documented cross-agency payments API layer is still described as the remaining gap, so not scored higher.
